content.short: Kuda is an African digital bank offering personal and business accounts, cards, savings, loans and payments.
content.description: Kuda, founded in 2019, is a leading African digital bank, often called the money app for Africans, serving millions of personal and business customers from its bases in Nigeria and the UK. Through its app it offers free and low-fee accounts, debit cards, instant transfers, savings and budgeting tools, overdrafts, loans and bill payments, plus business banking with payroll, expense cards, invoicing and POS for entrepreneurs and SMEs. Kuda targets Africans at home and in the diaspora who want accessible, mobile-first banking without the fees of traditional banks, and has expanded toward remittances for Nigerians abroad. By combining accounts, cards and credit at scale, it has become one of the continent's best-known neobanks.
